Real `claude -p` output (claude 2.1.287, Haiku 4.5, 2026-10-05), trimmed: the plugin list holds one invented entry (the real session listed about 70 installed plugins although none was active) and output_style is 'default' as with `--settings '{"outputStyle":"default"}'`; without that flag the real init said "Proactive" (the user's setting). Shapes, not values, are what tests may rely on. See docs/adr/ADR-009.
